INOX India Secures Large Orders, Including Global Space Project

INOX India has announced securing orders worth ₹939 crore, including a significant contract for a global space exploration project. These orders span industrial gas, LNG, and cryo-scientific solutions, reinforcing the company's position in the cryogenic systems market. The announcement led to a more than 5% increase in INOX India's share price on July 8.
